cc40f2184f43448025_5022967527569556269.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"去休息吧，不用操心，剩下的事我会处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb3947caca52c8560ed498a4919288bc_6186667974215232128.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·修女","content":"我？只是个无趣的人而已。如你所见，不爱教会也不爱工作。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/023c5456e20b8db3b3f8a4d801a2a853_7551772685415709400.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·麻烦","content":"那些值班修女一个比一个麻烦，不是抓人去祷告，就是叫人去唱诗班。你可别告诉她们我在这里。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/de9dec52147d1c6bec93be4ca3dd386e_170122121254754825.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·信仰","content":"神或许能庇护所有人，可他不会这样做。否则，人的苦难就成了笑话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a877250eb851d617ecf1fb2a53e29325_1236951176917347221.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·祷告","content":"祈祷吧。不是为了神或其他任何人，而是为了自己。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aab1cb9508b468cd5f0ea84880b79265_6662224486377414923.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·战斗","content":"不要勉强，有困难可以叫我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/966e5926b3487d7736917a7080cb91e5_9055873516318803462.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」可以是实力的证明，也可以是幸存的勋章…谁知道呢？真正的好东西总是具有两面性。我不会定义「神之眼」。我和它只是互相见证的关系罢了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dcaa3bfb3daf977b14b6411d13f822c9_6838545009400618360.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"要说什么是值得高兴的好事…呵，只是假设而已。如果有一天你遇到无法解决的难题，也别认为那就是人生的终点。说不定，会有人替你解决困境呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8d9ebd1c457b546470e219d8a9a4b71b_2733561552435192210.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"花草不属于我感兴趣的范畴。不过，蒲公英是个例外，它能酿出相当美味的蒲公英酒。休息时间来一杯，比睡懒觉还舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a8bfe7546557ee33a8f8920b1f0b0cc4_53796770976801014.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于迪卢克…","content":"一看就知道了吧？那位富豪老爷可不是个简单的人物。低调、自信…还有一点危险的气息。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7334399894eef16a05b080d4e785a025_6112680441141507438.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凯亚…","content":"人往往要到醉酒以后才会露出真面目。油嘴滑舌算是凯亚的保护色吧，呵，一目了然的伪装。你该看看他喝醉的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ff7fc07f1833e5f9430a3ec6d3c149c_5443375097108452758.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于温迪…","content":"这个吟游诗人身上有种非常特殊的气息…我还不能确定真相，但他与别的市民似乎很不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7d764107fe2df11661b3b8a41db7378b_8591240458151348432.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于芭芭拉…","content":"芭芭拉总是缠着我，叫我参加礼拜和唱诗班。难道维多利亚给她下了监督我工作的命令？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/950c267be7bca52985601fe32bec26fd_355575654079408358.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于琴…","content":"不仅完成本职工作，还会替他人收尾。值得钦佩的女人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cbe0b797ee8635014c08084258cfe72d_8568435011978315108.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"他就像一副挂在古旧房屋里的油画…厚重、神秘，无法被一眼看透。我不讨厌有故事的人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae8c0a3522a2877e6779d4b13b655982_2011721142147587419.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于丽莎…","content":"我不喜欢上班偷懒的人，不过也很能理解她准点下班的心情。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/20b2b06fb52e594f7eb078d979a89eb7_658364298828690868.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于可莉…","content":"唉，除了麻烦就是麻烦，虽然是可爱的麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f070017d34731c9e334690645bd32806_7566399762232540223.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于法尔伽…","content":"虽说是出于好意，但法尔伽啰嗦起来像个老头一样，相当在意身边的人呢。唉，那家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5727ea5ecaa526b966bef32336058ebb_579242757723206984.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于父亲…","content":"父亲？好遥远的词汇啊。对我而言可以说没有，也可以说有不止一个。怎么？很惊讶吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c0e850dfa09985662c035e0a0fb7e5b_7683273105251162587.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于塔利雅…","content":"主动请客是个好习惯，除此之外，他在酒桌上也很有分寸，知道什么该问，什么不该问。摸清彼此底牌后，我不必过多防备他，和聪明人打交道总是轻松的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/06/27/50494840/52379c1438b1daf2a4e199c31e1ef84c_2436648687367614859.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"关于塔利雅…cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其一","content":"跳过寒暄吧。我来这里是为了完成工作，你解决不了的问题可以移交给我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dca76e45b21f417ef660e93329bf0a48_3728116213460329793.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其二","content":"不信神的修女并不稀奇，就像世上也有不喜欢吃猪肉的猎人、讨厌鱼肉的渔民。做某一件事不代表爱它，不爱一件事也不意味着必须远离。工作就是这样的东西。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/217035882e96ad22766793a9c4bd19d9_2620272735191661788.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其三","content":"来一杯吗？这是今年的蒲公英酒，味道很不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc0b1368ce4244a90c8123242cd9b696_2483171400329719912.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其四","content":"蒙德是一头既古老又年轻的白色野兽，古老到需要人去保护，也年轻到无法独立生存。只有这样的地方才会需要我这样的人。我像其他修女照顾市民那样照顾着蒙德，让它在自由的道路上平稳前进。你问我为什么它是白色的？…因为像我这样的人，是黑色的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/641f4bbc3b0d4654c48ed50422073124_6671279729303270397.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其五","content":"我偶尔能感觉到过去每一年的自己都存在着、围绕着我…对我有所寄托。你一定也有相同的感觉，所以，哪怕如今你已走上截然不同的道路，也不要否认从前的自己。从前的每一个你，都是你脚下的基石。不要害怕过去，不要畏惧与它抗衡。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77cb1d33ce4d11ceda5d02b048edf4db_969279440003252495.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的爱好…","content":"小酌怡情，有些烦心事只能靠酒精解决。话虽如此，我是不会醉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bb0531709de3f48c95b2fa43efbab4c5_2714773896590558169.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的烦恼…","content":"唉…真不想参加下个月的合唱活动，可维多利亚亲自点名了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bf6e63474b6a7b70da4a267ea20cdee_6786753275354838973.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"试过红酒炖兽肉吗？酒精和大块的动物肉出现在一个盘子里，相当有品味。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/460c4197d3698acedc3288166a278813_1159269959738324959.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"这个…这个土豆饼的蘸料居然是果酱？完全不合理！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb426fd8500ef50b0461842bd87d697d_6302311877628746121.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"看来这方面，我们品味相投。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/84c5f140b8085cd872dd97d1ca1886a6_1731922072979577334.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"至少能填饱肚子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/fc048b967be569665a6f7be08da116a7_4140796153430368723.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你对这种食物很感兴趣吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a0475958760e4477c47db67173f49613_5716187039014121379.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你生日，有什么想处理的人或事吗？我可以帮个小忙，别告诉其他人就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9f26f327b757e3b3edfaaf1a7c814994_159293619163841574.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"嗯，感觉不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f564591c7b9526c2d87337ae2f8bafb_488626233360283096.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"需要帮忙吗？我现在有空。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cc47b5d8491dab17d76bb83c9b28519a_5807711615310705994.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"也好。能力越强，效率越高。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8d2b78f01c6920fcfded51533ff3aefa_3290210015239818783.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"哪怕是擅长战斗与杀戮的我，也从未拥有过如此强大的力量，谢谢你的祝福。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a7fc6df59cfcb5c9b063149d8e2c0ea5_2100879360945073105.mp3" 312a0865fe31db71cc4_2968924672626542741.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"去休息吧，不用操心，剩下的事我会处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5b3236043b73b901aa20a0347b612635_963124795589839337.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·修女","content":"我？只是个无趣的人而已。如你所见，不爱教会也不爱工作。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/88f607fa79ab078391a8b2ab82869b66_3972285251803803984.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·麻烦","content":"那些值班修女一个比一个麻烦，不是抓人去祷告，就是叫人去唱诗班。你可别告诉她们我在这里。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae354a83f017cbd03880ac345aed6cd9_1061308365313750365.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·信仰","content":"神或许能庇护所有人，可他不会这样做。否则，人的苦难就成了笑话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/74b763fa4ae37747de4353de21bce2f5_3543732669829552506.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·祷告","content":"祈祷吧。不是为了神或其他任何人，而是为了自己。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/83a005bd0dc976fbb5763c35441e5bb5_8526754857577345941.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·战斗","content":"不要勉强，有困难可以叫我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/55afb9176480db209da781ff937a1a6c_2713206886988094973.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」可以是实力的证明，也可以是幸存的勋章…谁知道呢？真正的好东西总是具有两面性。我不会定义「神之眼」。我和它只是互相见证的关系罢了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/32e2521ae704941a1c23fc8d36967d79_8391230742335948544.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"要说什么是值得高兴的好事…呵，只是假设而已。如果有一天你遇到无法解决的难题，也别认为那就是人生的终点。说不定，会有人替你解决困境呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e87813f6ee1ee9cdb867d976a8876d3a_1870168665430030539.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"花草不属于我感兴趣的范畴。不过，蒲公英是个例外，它能酿出相当美味的蒲公英酒。休息时间来一杯，比睡懒觉还舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd91333e75aed2887cb05599dcac382c_9164913528826133444.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于迪卢克…","content":"一看就知道了吧？那位富豪老爷可不是个简单的人物。低调、自信…还有一点危险的气息。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2dffead5dba5c4a60160384c59de58f9_1717933471067137344.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凯亚…","content":"人往往要到醉酒以后才会露出真面目。油嘴滑舌算是凯亚的保护色吧，呵，一目了然的伪装。你该看看他喝醉的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ca4591b9c1ba6db625b8099458f2e16c_3999642927851578453.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于温迪…","content":"这个吟游诗人身上有种非常特殊的气息…我还不能确定真相，但他与别的市民似乎很不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31e27ed6ba84bc4afa069809906b6690_4370555575641872717.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于芭芭拉…","content":"芭芭拉总是缠着我，叫我参加礼拜和唱诗班。难道维多利亚给她下了监督我工作的命令？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5b31a86cbf5e50326093a97e7a2aa0b7_4243452572982735745.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于琴…","content":"不仅完成本职工作，还会替他人收尾。值得钦佩的女人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f4e399a7bda1f45aa72edd70f58635ad_3603824942114301622.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"他就像一副挂在古旧房屋里的油画…厚重、神秘，无法被一眼看透。我不讨厌有故事的人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c0d2cfc6dcaf62b19765ad8ac938f10_2925283976447259975.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于丽莎…","content":"我不喜欢上班偷懒的人，不过也很能理解她准点下班的心情。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3873fd2261442b0fac4b21e35d11e61d_8266773213662563296.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于可莉…","content":"唉，除了麻烦就是麻烦，虽然是可爱的麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/58abfaae387799eacae9a5e51c670512_5982272268071042297.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于法尔伽…","content":"虽说是出于好意，但法尔伽啰嗦起来像个老头一样，相当在意身边的人呢。唉，那家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bdf9cbf0f1b27cdc94b5256118087b02_1277192258297305088.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于父亲…","content":"父亲？好遥远的词汇啊。对我而言可以说没有，也可以说有不止一个。怎么？很惊讶吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/19a6fd15b5204f1123c86bf2a562e9df_849320917938687223.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于塔利雅…","content":"主动请客是个好习惯，除此之外，他在酒桌上也很有分寸，知道什么该问，什么不该问。摸清彼此底牌后，我不必过多防备他，和聪明人打交道总是轻松的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/06/27/50494840/1486760ab1fadb3bcd21e81aef91db1d_42015182278620661.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"关于塔利雅…jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其一","content":"跳过寒暄吧。我来这里是为了完成工作，你解决不了的问题可以移交给我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bac492e7c806c291778360f2494aabe6_1384209670621704054.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其二","content":"不信神的修女并不稀奇，就像世上也有不喜欢吃猪肉的猎人、讨厌鱼肉的渔民。做某一件事不代表爱它，不爱一件事也不意味着必须远离。工作就是这样的东西。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/78edaa907f6a21fb63a01f3d8f24ea2f_4332082146006511132.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其三","content":"来一杯吗？这是今年的蒲公英酒，味道很不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0bd098dd4bb32a40e7ab71d12d01b540_1346671938341630571.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其四","content":"蒙德是一头既古老又年轻的白色野兽，古老到需要人去保护，也年轻到无法独立生存。只有这样的地方才会需要我这样的人。我像其他修女照顾市民那样照顾着蒙德，让它在自由的道路上平稳前进。你问我为什么它是白色的？…因为像我这样的人，是黑色的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9f312f8e15d6f04a4feb7e2824e3b8fa_2950433689418616266.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其五","content":"我偶尔能感觉到过去每一年的自己都存在着、围绕着我…对我有所寄托。你一定也有相同的感觉，所以，哪怕如今你已走上截然不同的道路，也不要否认从前的自己。从前的每一个你，都是你脚下的基石。不要害怕过去，不要畏惧与它抗衡。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a677a038020a97488b80566c86ef275_8843784262238047267.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的爱好…","content":"小酌怡情，有些烦心事只能靠酒精解决。话虽如此，我是不会醉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5347a0ba5c098f0cfa61a61a73453b32_4666382134158973718.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的烦恼…","content":"唉…真不想参加下个月的合唱活动，可维多利亚亲自点名了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1b4b5904aa245dc6f29a7f9efd597aba_6225354221226604283.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"试过红酒炖兽肉吗？酒精和大块的动物肉出现在一个盘子里，相当有品味。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fe0fc566ed517dc278dfe7944bf61b64_3984599563842087155.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"这个…这个土豆饼的蘸料居然是果酱？完全不合理！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b7829000e3186f7c0d62b2a7ffa98ba7_5558018478101225113.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"看来这方面，我们品味相投。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ca2190c584bde8966f7d68a188e64e7c_8297728587293576549.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"至少能填饱肚子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/d26f9b622034749daaff18e20e05d3d8_1052316349163376969.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你对这种食物很感兴趣吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e941893322fd24e77bd116d0916f78a3_276145697338028580.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你生日，有什么想处理的人或事吗？我可以帮个小忙，别告诉其他人就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/779988d9f2429e561528982fa2f4fab9_6665939959669544402.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"嗯，感觉不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/780a84c21c05a97cab453cad2e4bbf8f_6386536623182779782.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"需要帮忙吗？我现在有空。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f3cf07f3a48fea92150d5b44b6e5b9f4_599658733496330846.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"也好。能力越强，效率越高。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/55ac14f39b599439e1326d1a65f29349_4543338374600350599.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"哪怕是擅长战斗与杀戮的我，也从未拥有过如此强大的力量，谢谢你的祝福。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e671060d69567a275a79cc515d2afdc6_7610651712360919295.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"嘿呀！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bc7ca2803be0f9af4ee02d7dc28e8a4_7131277766484812477.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"审判！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b97bec8ac5b581ea296c1a54dba20573_1825888779083588039.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"别想跑！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aa64bce825eb7b28a73340e8e80307c5_1580650631756022784.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"制裁！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c2b636c1bba2f41de549e762951aca81_1827775751198716369.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"战栗吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/029ec30f63b2098299bab95b6a0d9de0_6357523458758643122.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"晚安了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/40f3b9837a640e4ed2bc45fbd08678e5_5720091615235273793.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"…倒也有不错的玩意。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9c576cac18cc15828c9f14373c995ac6_4714634121395881913.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"还行，不算很麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9132214fc10029ef710833a4d67a49d1_3650738477959154305.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"心情不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/276a044a39fbb851018c922ba069cb28_1764114512595086073.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"没想到…哼。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/be8ca7ae5001389746fdbcdd01420a64_2441671860399029515.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"得加个班了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ad122c3a46d2392a324b84bf5580c58_5613980723828904612.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"有两下子！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bbe804592e2a9e10d78dc6ae02ed8ff6_6379913864192514377.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"退后！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/f064b9a0c693267cc18fc30a07d4f522_7686119719912204186.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"不要恋战！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/4e05f4d90dc74d434de5e2dde68df352_2110912750909591406.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"这样也好…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d1fb0cb06fba9917f97d299c98247a54_6939041039850668722.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"或许是…命中注定…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/14f8d513a95d7d9019d26fd140e99b50_3512084712189832324.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"唔…到此为止了吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e9fbcc960267bf883f9effa50e88f4ed_9010698205774823089.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不过如此。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0605ccd2cf4abe5de1f041589d9e939e_4940154658609120226.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"啧，真麻烦！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/67c8ef1b9d9b370b86fce00dcbf5f425_256356740732140656.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"又有新工作了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cb1626db4891f0c956d45833ebde6064_5538724341891958876.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"但愿配合顺利。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/38c7b562f2225cc9131e0a776a0a0f0d_80034443276147032.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"呼…速战速决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c3ec986cdd0b0205da0769e7a3c6519_592750396064735819.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703216096593_1"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"这位信徒，如果遇到难以解决的麻烦，可以来找我，如果只想祈祷，还请找其他修女。

…嗯？你不是信徒吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dbfd2bfa6b25cfe4c38e1778de60a990_4161797155701092472.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无聊","content":"还不走吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/378695a09b4a7a0abca58278b63d0d6e_4533759336956365962.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·加班","content":"什么都可以商量，除了加班。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/69880b9e450072f958a23d3ca0963a42_6728201822957329052.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·蒙德生活","content":"好好完成工作，好好度过每一天。蒙德的生活不就是如此吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fe8bd14b713008c2652eb46ce92272ee_1216499121418695220.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"唉，影响效率。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3898a32845817ae60ff3745b92eee6c8_1755327985301131102.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"嘁，麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6dbea3d644acae9e764e53cf466500b6_1434245158268083626.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"雪天赶路，最好小心一些。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/54ac0549bde54693026c0a9c37d0471d_4581257422281005145.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"是风神巴斯巴托的庇佑吗？等等，好像是巴托巴斯…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bcf4b7b7ddbcae37a9d11b5a781fad70_3085993542476337729.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安，哈…晨祷已经开始了吗？也太早了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d358c15ea41b488eaeafb5cdc05c8c4b_5941543273778729671.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午后的阳光对睡眠有好处。你也试试吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb1feb69e829593a8cb1b42a344846bc_200048910687241814.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚上好。晚间祷告的话，我不参加。嗯？不为什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6ac8ebf1760d03d6b57d7e0fadc2a1e2_2520545632251015447.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"去休息吧，不用操心，剩下的事我会处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b1efc40b7a7e6788b1639bd36ad1d8c3_4916873096984307036.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·修女","content":"我？只是个无趣的人而已。如你所见，不爱教会也不爱工作。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d7501293d59101f34a00289cc556a7f2_5870118955089212204.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·麻烦","content":"那些值班修女一个比一个麻烦，不是抓人去祷告，就是叫人去唱诗班。你可别告诉她们我在这里。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0b9872f5035099ad0be2f892d04ca100_2026731093165616503.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·信仰","content":"神或许能庇护所有人，可他不会这样做。否则，人的苦难就成了笑话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0140fa0d97fcff1de6bd7e716bfddb5b_24979477607218043.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·祷告","content":"祈祷吧。不是为了神或其他任何人，而是为了自己。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e8a9c16ceba3e3a891e984b3241ee508_6072077345505811637.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·战斗","content":"不要勉强，有困难可以叫我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fc4b8ac258c657f224d9b04ec76b3653_8422859479363483657.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」可以是实力的证明，也可以是幸存的勋章…谁知道呢？真正的好东西总是具有两面性。我不会定义「神之眼」。我和它只是互相见证的关系罢了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f25009dfd6dbafbe7c884a6bfd1b4089_2216945824894099392.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"要说什么是值得高兴的好事…呵，只是假设而已。如果有一天你遇到无法解决的难题，也别认为那就是人生的终点。说不定，会有人替你解决困境呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/931b41a46638ebdf453d6c1304e47811_1400906549478582474.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"花草不属于我感兴趣的范畴。不过，蒲公英是个例外，它能酿出相当美味的蒲公英酒。休息时间来一杯，比睡懒觉还舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/963696f8429977bab7b75f46a7ca4734_3706299180763910682.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于迪卢克…","content":"一看就知道了吧？那位富豪老爷可不是个简单的人物。低调、自信…还有一点危险的气息。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c4e4c719f3ab92a310cd5c709399dc90_5312071263297294712.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凯亚…","content":"人往往要到醉酒以后才会露出真面目。油嘴滑舌算是凯亚的保护色吧，呵，一目了然的伪装。你该看看他喝醉的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5418ea467eb36c6bbcd49ea0f605eee0_4636077119196558410.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于温迪…","content":"这个吟游诗人身上有种非常特殊的气息…我还不能确定真相，但他与别的市民似乎很不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7e97061020ada5ed6d00919f0801b9b5_4291071441083709231.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于芭芭拉…","content":"芭芭拉总是缠着我，叫我参加礼拜和唱诗班。难道维多利亚给她下了监督我工作的命令？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aea408e361670b1ec34dc42b2cdb8a7d_744580690471401258.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于琴…","content":"不仅完成本职工作，还会替他人收尾。值得钦佩的女人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ca66634055778afe9e613e1a1f838c5_3589251047442827998.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"他就像一副挂在古旧房屋里的油画…厚重、神秘，无法被一眼看透。我不讨厌有故事的人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b4f79ba167613936312518832cbff8f1_1372087162169796231.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于丽莎…","content":"我不喜欢上班偷懒的人，不过也很能理解她准点下班的心情。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c43781fd3b0db68d8794d2a23fc3e96_8999646097545291976.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于可莉…","content":"唉，除了麻烦就是麻烦，虽然是可爱的麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/09e2eb13683984f38fd8dfa966ed2bcc_5606036828026667110.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于法尔伽…","content":"虽说是出于好意，但法尔伽啰嗦起来像个老头一样，相当在意身边的人呢。唉，那家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/36c371a20c63aee5abdd26f303ae3a43_7389270758284595357.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于父亲…","content":"父亲？好遥远的词汇啊。对我而言可以说没有，也可以说有不止一个。怎么？很惊讶吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/70bc58bf83c3f0905ababe012c20efe4_5532944560600201052.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于塔利雅…","content":"主动请客是个好习惯，除此之外，他在酒桌上也很有分寸，知道什么该问，什么不该问。摸清彼此底牌后，我不必过多防备他，和聪明人打交道总是轻松的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/06/27/50494840/84f54ea5dde0481e36943905e7be8fe0_1334241776287054910.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"关于塔利雅…kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其一","content":"跳过寒暄吧。我来这里是为了完成工作，你解决不了的问题可以移交给我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/07e6c2cffd28aa6a8c254c84e34a88d6_977428749980538614.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其二","content":"不信神的修女并不稀奇，就像世上也有不喜欢吃猪肉的猎人、讨厌鱼肉的渔民。做某一件事不代表爱它，不爱一件事也不意味着必须远离。工作就是这样的东西。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f56cc8d3ece195d33a09bf49a7bd1c8b_4856881600477075229.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其三","content":"来一杯吗？这是今年的蒲公英酒，味道很不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ca5b60e61c00aa49cf844b610af1ba4e_794043872858183757.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其四","content":"蒙德是一头既古老又年轻的白色野兽，古老到需要人去保护，也年轻到无法独立生存。只有这样的地方才会需要我这样的人。我像其他修女照顾市民那样照顾着蒙德，让它在自由的道路上平稳前进。你问我为什么它是白色的？…因为像我这样的人，是黑色的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/724ace27a1eb4b910d8b0ed42a47b5c5_6546593229981523964.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其五","content":"我偶尔能感觉到过去每一年的自己都存在着、围绕着我…对我有所寄托。你一定也有相同的感觉，所以，哪怕如今你已走上截然不同的道路，也不要否认从前的自己。从前的每一个你，都是你脚下的基石。不要害怕过去，不要畏惧与它抗衡。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b21fd832fca44ed74839b2bd8ad5003d_8083845806768801297.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的爱好…","content":"小酌怡情，有些烦心事只能靠酒精解决。话虽如此，我是不会醉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0a3f69804290777a4923dd2d69dd7ec6_6786412049853666432.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的烦恼…","content":"唉…真不想参加下个月的合唱活动，可维多利亚亲自点名了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6abace8020619321335ed6855f8694aa_8797868145543688286.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"试过红酒炖兽肉吗？酒精和大块的动物肉出现在一个盘子里，相当有品味。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/80d4e8a3a2b4980dcbf320c9225db7a6_959179478471062414.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"这个…这个土豆饼的蘸料居然是果酱？完全不合理！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77a63618fdc57539252db789ec57c8fe_1442329501899760345.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"看来这方面，我们品味相投。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/981a1c1fe52731dedd3f4ff238bf8399_3150912070199186680.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"至少能填饱肚子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/09c187de3a78b460ef483409a2c0a615_9010376538024197213.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你对这种食物很感兴趣吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e3a008306d6c00c48d8c78513f18b6dc_5127593068001774309.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你生日，有什么想处理的人或事吗？我可以帮个小忙，别告诉其他人就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/49a7173228f30f853b03065d40568911_4101138522574115594.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"嗯，感觉不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e4fe3d815396e962fa2be9d90f364e4a_6998981372568564577.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"需要帮忙吗？我现在有空。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a61931aa507d41cff35701e8aa6895d6_3254327176548918766.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"也好。能力越强，效率越高。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/be787464df6bba17e6cd1d75c685fa6a_1895349945432270406.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"哪怕是擅长战斗与杀戮的我，也从未拥有过如此强大的力量，谢谢你的祝福。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0e03a4823a129442cab080dbca9f66f4_8923478013277048603.m …嗯？你不是信徒吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/088d4858f4c3bcbb3f2b1a88e59d3b56_7141626146790833262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·无聊","content":"还不走吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/62ad97560f38ddcea8ac0f23cafa2502_239916593599616115.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·加班","content":"什么都可以商量，除了加班。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9c77471f89bff37e814ba52429be7f6b_6985924114849029214.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·蒙德生活","content":"好好完成工作，好好度过每一天。蒙德的生活不就是如此吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f484f7c06b48314a49057c9dc09169f3_3125438522074886718.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"唉，影响效率。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2181ff583bdd576576aa90a64fe84917_5353703270045899241.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"嘁，麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/df19ca30b91e31609701c9469bd6df2a_117612791267056796.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"雪天赶路，最好小心一些。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5b0ef75b31f0f1e6e9ee28f8037696d5_6696141418562401811.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"是风神巴斯巴托的庇佑吗？等等，好像是巴托巴斯…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ad29d488fd1819d6c5388a202818796d_2072550955092830685.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安，哈…晨祷已经开始了吗？也太早了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/db453eac8743d05f415e1541ae985b08_930032776456348377.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午后的阳光对睡眠有好处。你也试试吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/89cdf1e5e34c8f6dd54666ba3ab9cf99_1314360596990269256.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚上好。晚间祷告的话，我不参加。嗯？不为什么。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bb8327f7785a5611cffa40372c9571d6_8665116501125065159.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"去休息吧，不用操心，剩下的事我会处理。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/490efca56dc96deb1ae79126637f8274_8407423611686245730.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·修女","content":"我？只是个无趣的人而已。如你所见，不爱教会也不爱工作。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fa4f018fa883ba29e88d22a7c9049d54_6325640858308486028.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于罗莎莉亚自己·麻烦","content":"那些值班修女一个比一个麻烦，不是抓人去祷告，就是叫人去唱诗班。你可别告诉她们我在这里。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d1c7e14d66c09f7617a18ef302ec5ab8_4741101860410584835.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·信仰","content":"神或许能庇护所有人，可他不会这样做。否则，人的苦难就成了笑话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/00a75caf73d75c7a4f503e94a4e98396_7161672003543917258.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·祷告","content":"祈祷吧。不是为了神或其他任何人，而是为了自己。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f0a7147ed4782e42369b98bd7fc8c35b_6633126532987626934.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·战斗","content":"不要勉强，有困难可以叫我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c32950c0e8369b07743659fa85f7f2a9_3126990591360241266.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」可以是实力的证明，也可以是幸存的勋章…谁知道呢？真正的好东西总是具有两面性。我不会定义「神之眼」。我和它只是互相见证的关系罢了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9490a052e230a4c2714a6d0b8d9baa13_8591555616478750059.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"要说什么是值得高兴的好事…呵，只是假设而已。如果有一天你遇到无法解决的难题，也别认为那就是人生的终点。说不定，会有人替你解决困境呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c8556c56bcfd7be0d61fa596488c8c0_6130689374074783811.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"花草不属于我感兴趣的范畴。不过，蒲公英是个例外，它能酿出相当美味的蒲公英酒。休息时间来一杯，比睡懒觉还舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6f5b0944cd3aae52e8843611ccb88835_2128469889331581042.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于迪卢克…","content":"一看就知道了吧？那位富豪老爷可不是个简单的人物。低调、自信…还有一点危险的气息。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/43f53c09b42a9023500fc8c83f860afe_1800233597784116788.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凯亚…","content":"人往往要到醉酒以后才会露出真面目。油嘴滑舌算是凯亚的保护色吧，呵，一目了然的伪装。你该看看他喝醉的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/829f22a0f8d3bc6c2413b253298e4a01_3513396273902925627.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于温迪…","content":"这个吟游诗人身上有种非常特殊的气息…我还不能确定真相，但他与别的市民似乎很不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/50880c418fd70f0e478d862e10b9b956_3086265435810965526.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于芭芭拉…","content":"芭芭拉总是缠着我，叫我参加礼拜和唱诗班。难道维多利亚给她下了监督我工作的命令？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a73a11f76bf949908573987a44f9a210_1615693584577235451.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于琴…","content":"不仅完成本职工作，还会替他人收尾。值得钦佩的女人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c57ce0c0e3865489bbbff800a585064_2830655475961311491.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于阿贝多…","content":"他就像一副挂在古旧房屋里的油画…厚重、神秘，无法被一眼看透。我不讨厌有故事的人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e98a22be409ce0c74876f616cd801a9c_7582532382041986411.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于丽莎…","content":"我不喜欢上班偷懒的人，不过也很能理解她准点下班的心情。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7aa1cc73cab708f2d8f39d0670bf7012_2431719933782604708.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于可莉…","content":"唉，除了麻烦就是麻烦，虽然是可爱的麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/23a028833d2aa0d968218f0816760ee2_1392049819631116328.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于法尔伽…","content":"虽说是出于好意，但法尔伽啰嗦起来像个老头一样，相当在意身边的人呢。唉，那家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c247fc02706252be2c3072e3ecbe6d9_6660241395708683841.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于父亲…","content":"父亲？好遥远的词汇啊。对我而言可以说没有，也可以说有不止一个。怎么？很惊讶吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dee7a643021f2efae5cca2833d9aa604_1419892466181018528.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于塔利雅…","content":"主动请客是个好习惯，除此之外，他在酒桌上也很有分寸，知道什么该问，什么不该问。摸清彼此底牌后，我不必过多防备他，和聪明人打交道总是轻松的。","audio_url":"","isUploading":false},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其一","content":"跳过寒暄吧。我来这里是为了完成工作，你解决不了的问题可以移交给我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/188910ea497bfbe3733c4658089484ac_1957798522863132832.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其二","content":"不信神的修女并不稀奇，就像世上也有不喜欢吃猪肉的猎人、讨厌鱼肉的渔民。做某一件事不代表爱它，不爱一件事也不意味着必须远离。工作就是这样的东西。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/03bdcf9bc8d650a56f56639c0bbaa340_4728163918952178945.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其三","content":"来一杯吗？这是今年的蒲公英酒，味道很不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6ffecc4c96c65c80f50c85df17e02864_2951468481998202771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其四","content":"蒙德是一头既古老又年轻的白色野兽，古老到需要人去保护，也年轻到无法独立生存。只有这样的地方才会需要我这样的人。我像其他修女照顾市民那样照顾着蒙德，让它在自由的道路上平稳前进。你问我为什么它是白色的？…因为像我这样的人，是黑色的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/722870dd2a536707e39375800839d269_6426312845995446388.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解罗莎莉亚·其五","content":"我偶尔能感觉到过去每一年的自己都存在着、围绕着我…对我有所寄托。你一定也有相同的感觉，所以，哪怕如今你已走上截然不同的道路，也不要否认从前的自己。从前的每一个你，都是你脚下的基石。不要害怕过去，不要畏惧与它抗衡。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7394d7216cc143b556c97b2578d3c8c8_2660257304889915909.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的爱好…","content":"小酌怡情，有些烦心事只能靠酒精解决。话虽如此，我是不会醉的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0e25802aaea2bc29e5d329757d96af00_7685072773302220602.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"罗莎莉亚的烦恼…","content":"唉…真不想参加下个月的合唱活动，可维多利亚亲自点名了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/57203016cb9292733b47c213448dfe37_1697838733967751170.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"试过红酒炖兽肉吗？酒精和大块的动物肉出现在一个盘子里，相当有品味。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aa5dfc5f039bbde9074b04f9d8b9d3ba_2934693178700133736.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"这个…这个土豆饼的蘸料居然是果酱？完全不合理！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/14c7d44b3756a8b315cb9a2b506a4189_2446127575218906924.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"看来这方面，我们品味相投。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a1ea478120e1d6387764babd53b6a676_8585394215289807137.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"至少能填饱肚子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a9abf3685d9f8d17946a87ac87e4017e_2098690410978200950.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"你对这种食物很感兴趣吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/1dd1b4580906dfbdee4d730e701e86a9_6616004328549434506.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你生日，有什么想处理的人或事吗？我可以帮个小忙，别告诉其他人就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/37ff892b237f70a5b93c250a03706efd_5075609039367955763.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"嗯，感觉不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8ec3be86e606df9f21b84b799eeed756_1385322964942494871.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"需要帮忙吗？我现在有空。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0a26fe332ce9adc38608c21d979bbd9_496032469396638859.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"也好。能力越强，效率越高。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2c36587916fc24a2cf91ab3d6aeb44f1_7484331479574316804.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"哪怕是擅长战斗与杀戮的我，也从未拥有过如此强大的力量，谢谢你的祝福。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/28cc9ff048cbc62d40aa4be8929b4fdb_5667232636649335878.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"嘿呀！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/60c086ee8ee3a30acf974c1382e204ff_2885932203994975847.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"审判！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ab731dd53266ceae68b421c9f6f2c4c_3155593671638031255.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"别想跑！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2ac0350e2a9346378f213ea108e274b2_4434973083231304502.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"制裁！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e41d967c19b3b02cae59db01daddf28e_3714654491179670863.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"战栗吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c770a37bab595f364329caeea0c0256_8246864440491051618.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"晚安了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a00c3c3692e293bdba345e34b14a31a_4136480675278448071.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"…倒也有不错的玩意。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0b909f5466bf528ce187e348aec9672_1851594413900494763.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"还行，不算很麻烦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c83a584b2f6585bab4efcf48e4e507c5_6252609065003326060.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"心情不错。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5fb12c0c5686937411fc1cc8f4bf40bd_1496182680368240921.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"没想到…哼。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc589888b1d0de856674ad1146cb9830_7633354593845205756.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"得加个班了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/afd3c6f34e07b1d8e242c8d7fba4d180_4509439003133605437.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"有两下子！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/084b4b9c686a8af9d2f45b6869d5b7af_709942819795780615.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"退后！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ce2ae651b3a399d6ab04789291217460_3466224017394505442.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"不要恋战！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/11/04/16576950/3238945d732aa16edb7bf5818fc3ccbf_2615981749456161125.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"这样也好…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ea6b4acd1a77f83d4b128b9515dc9ba_3468211898144722574.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"或许是…命中注定…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dec8c84a46a1b3ed6c3c8544034dcb45_3565064468623761688.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"唔…到此为止了吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/97b53654125ce12122348ee76a0cc86a_285654148973408583.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不过如此。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d2021da8a0eae932c0af76e85abb57c_6305160709123435220.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"啧，真麻烦！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/76cd177d25f5f8a347602fbc1dab7d9a_5319630225865786239.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"又有新工作了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7efd4b1be5fda515d4ce056674f28014_6603765978348772559.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"但愿配合顺利。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/78cbe18625abc68e4c3814dc56778d26_903648845968456488.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"呼…速战速决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2b5b421e6f67a628afc155fd01053bfd_5439587145832196044.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703216096593_3"}]}

单凭那些不守规矩的行为，罗莎莉亚就够被教会记过一百次了。

但不知为何，她似乎没在这方面吃过苦头。不和同僚们一起行动，也鲜少出现在与市民联欢的场合。

神奇又神秘的罗莎莉亚就像一缕黑烟，一不注意便消失得无影无踪。

她的人际关系也很单薄，几乎不跟谁来往。

不过据维多利亚修女说，好心的芭芭拉一直在尝试靠近罗莎莉亚。

请你别在教堂内抽烟、请你准时参加典礼…

还有…喂喂，请听我说话呀！

操碎了心的芭芭拉总是追在罗莎莉亚身后，督促她完成各种日常工作。

面对蒙德城人人喜欢的偶像芭芭拉，罗莎莉亚却无动于衷。

她该不会…是个铁石心肠的人吧？

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

罗莎莉亚行踪叵测，时常不告而别，一消失就是好几天。

每逢此时，教会的同僚们都不知该去哪里找她。

某位有意监督她的修女总是为此诉苦：「就算是捡来的野猫，也、也该打声招呼再跑掉吧…！」

消失的罗莎莉亚，会在人们看不见的角落处理只有她能完成的工作。

陌生的商贾，可疑的旅客，这些人是否对蒙德有害？

调查、跟踪，如有必要，还有拷问。

如果他们应当消失，罗莎莉亚一定是最后见到他们的人。

不见天日的黑色工作，都由罗莎莉亚一手包办。

她总在日落后出发，一口气完成任务。有时踏着拂晓的晨曦归来，还能喝上一杯早餐酒。

蒙德人生活在金色的阳光下，罗莎莉亚则活跃在银色的月光下。

银白、剔透的冷光…就像她擅长的冰元素法术一样。

「有些事还不需要让年轻人知道。」

对罗莎莉亚而言，活在阳光下的蒙德人，不论年龄大小，都能算是「年轻人」。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

对任何事都漫不经心的罗莎莉亚，犹如一阵难以捉摸的烟雾。

但这样的她一旦进入工作，便会秉持公事公办的态度全力完成任务。

看似懒散的罗莎莉亚，拷问可疑人士时从不手软。

不仅如此，她的手劲异常之大，对人体弱点了若指掌，对杀人一事也没有什么负面情绪。

悠闲懒散的烟鬼修女，背地里竟是实力拔尖的处刑人。

生活在神的光芒之下，却背负着这般使命。

为什么成为双手染血的处刑人？为什么不愿歌颂神的庇佑？

更何况，罗莎莉亚不是土生土长的蒙德人。

「像这种幸福无趣之城，总得有做脏活的人吧。」

罗莎莉亚掸了掸烟，懒洋洋地说。

「对我而言，做这些比过正统修女生活简单多了。」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

即便是完全不做祷告的罗莎莉亚也对神学有着独特见解。

依她所见，自由是蒙德人的精神支柱，而促成她在此落脚的，正是这份自由。

罗莎莉亚诞生在一座偏僻山村，出生后不久就被—伙血洗该村庄的盗贼团劫走。

被盗贼抚养长大的她自幼便学习战斗技巧，一边当着盗贼，一边干着团里的杂活。

既是奴仆，又是机器；既是盗贼，又是孩子。

与外人战斗，也与同伴战斗；在饥寒中挣扎，在竞争中长大。

罗莎莉亚的青春时代，正如同蒙德的夕阳——目所能及均是血色，抬起头来才发觉时光已晚。

这伙盗贼团，于数年后被西风骑士团剿灭。身为最年轻的成员，罗莎莉亚被认为还有悔过的余地。

骑士团长法尔伽带她来到蒙德。他衷心祝愿罗莎莉亚能融入蒙德，告诫她道：

「去教会，在神的光辉下洗净自己。你可以重新来过，像普通人一样生活。」

可法尔伽没有料到，罗莎莉亚屡屡逃课，无故旷掉唱诗班工作。

宁可在野外打猎也不愿做个安分的修女。对她来说，金色阳光才是刺眼之物。而罗莎莉亚早在许多年前就已明白：她是月亮的孩子，迟早会回归到黑暗中去。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

教会第一翘班王罗莎莉亚，在其修习时代就已是远近闻名的逃课王。

「罗莎莉亚小姐，请注意你的行为！身为成员，你居然完全不出席唱诗班活动！」

「稍安勿躁，奥菲拉修女。罗莎莉亚小姐，我听说，必修课程你一节都没来上过？」

「是的。」

「对了玛利亚夫人，请看这个…罗莎莉亚的神学论文根本是一团糟！」

「罗莎莉亚小姐，恕我直言，你打算留在教会工作吗？」

「不打算。我已经找到别的工作了。」

罗莎莉亚对此毫无紧张感。她确实更适合做些黑色工作。

没想到的是，这份工作最终挂在了教会名下。

「见习修女」罗莎莉亚并未摆脱神职人员头衔，而是顺利升成了「修女」罗莎莉亚。

不出任务时，她尽一切可能逃避教会活动——去酒馆喝酒，或是到城墙上眺望风景。

哪怕实在无法躲避，也绝不愿超时工作。一到下班时间，罗莎莉亚就会准点消失。不论是明面上还是暗地里，她的原则都是：绝不加班。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

白色封皮的笔记本。封面上有着「西风教会」的字样。

笔记主人写得一手好字，笔记内容却是各种无聊摘抄。

「蒲公英酒，全场八折！」

「渔人吐司，用你意想不到的价格，享受梦中美味！」

「小麦折扣力度惊人，需要帮忙磨成面粉可以给店主留言。」

「番茄买三送一！」

「新鲜的小灯草，可以放在洗手间当照明用具哦！先生，看看吧…！」

洒脱而又美观的字迹，写下的却是各种叫卖口号与商店标语。

这本笔记本是罗莎莉亚见习修女时代的产物。

不难猜测，她一翘课就会跑去商店街的楼顶偷懒，一边晒太阳，一边听写底下传来的各种吆喝。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

罗莎莉亚的「神之眼」出现在某个寒冷的夜晚。

那是盗贼团最窘迫的时期，口粮不足以养活所有人。

她总是吃不饱饭，因无法忍受饿着肚子在寒风里做粗活而逃走。

盗贼团的老人将她追了回来。他正是将她从出生村庄捡走、教她杀人技法的人。

「逃跑的都是叛徒，叛徒只有赢得决斗才能获得自由。」

老人将一把旧匕首丢给罗莎莉亚。

「来吧，杀了我才可能离开这里。我是暮年的狮子了，你还年轻。能做到的吧？」

几乎没人相信罗莎莉亚真能杀死他。可老狮确实死在了初生的野兽爪下。

那一晚，盗贼团失去一个老成员，接纳一名新成员。

有趣的是，盗贼们起先不愿接纳杀死老人的罗莎莉亚，却在看见她手上那颗「神之眼」后改变了主意。

——有「神之眼」的人肯定比快老死的贼厉害。再说，你吃得也少，还能节约些粮食。

罗莎莉亚冰块般凝结的心中忽然浮出一个疑问：

他是故意让我顶替他吗？…捡来的孩子，也会让虚假的父亲产生包庇之心吗？

关于罗莎莉亚…

法尔伽

嗯…为了避免事后被她嫌多嘴，我还是保持沉默吧。她的那种眼神还是挺有寒意的。有什么想了解的，可以直接去问她。我想她现在…应该已经愿意跟你们谈及往事了。

塔利雅

我和罗莎莉亚算是知根知底的好朋友，也早就习惯了她平时不在教堂。不过刚认识的时候，她非常不愿意与我分享她的秘密。后来我找到了一种总是能抓到她的办法，她才和我进行了互利的交易。

凯亚

啊哈哈，你想知道罗莎莉亚修女的秘密吗？这个不能说。不过我对她印象还不错，比某人好多了。她能够诚实地面对自己。烂事就是烂事，提不起干劲就是提不起干劲。

芭芭拉

罗莎莉亚修女虽然难以接近，也从不参加祈祷，但我觉得…唔，她一定是相信着风神的！不过，不过我并没有勇气和她交流就是了…

菲谢尔

菲谢尔：她吗？似乎是虔信风神的忠实修女呢。

奥兹：「虔信」？「忠实」？

菲谢尔：没错。有天晚上看到过，她对什么人说「以风神巴托巴斯的名义，去死吧」这样的话，想必是在领祷吧。

琴

罗莎莉亚修女总是把「麻烦」挂在嘴边，实际却十分称职。上次我和她说「如果觉得麻烦也可以找我帮忙」，她却回答「这样更麻烦」。嗯…我果然还有很多欠缺啊。

主题：被迫工作…

发件人：罗莎莉亚

时间：2026-01-24

今天不巧，撞上了最忙的工作日…

晨祷期间，维多利亚告诉我们，枢机卿不久后要回蒙德，让我们打起百分百的劲来。

瞧她说的，好像我哪天没打起百分百的劲似的…不过，芭芭拉反而是打起了更大的劲头，拉着我和塔利雅又是整理桌椅，又是擦教堂的玻璃还说想要写新的颂歌…

倒是不奇怪，毕竟枢机卿大人可是芭芭拉的…

算了，不说这些。总之我已经闲下来了，有空的话来酒馆找我吧，我们俩喝一点，就当作是庆祝生日了，塔利雅说不定也要来，挺好的，那就大家一起吧。

主题：敬你。

发件人：罗莎莉亚

时间：2025-01-24

今天晨祷，塔利雅没有劳烦其他修女来抓我。凭我的了解，这就算是他送我的生日礼物了。正好也是我所需要的。

只不过，徒有清净的生日还算不上完美。

蒙德美酒众多，独特的风味不一定只存在于酒馆，就比如清泉镇有些猎户会在冬日里启封珍藏的私酿。我能理解这种心态。在阴影中经历了漫长的蹲伏，不论捕获与否，都值得来上几口犒劳自己…顺便，除了大人的饮料，猎人们的烤肉手艺也不错。

来吗？赏光分享分享你的英雄事迹？

敬你一杯。

主题：难得…

发件人：罗莎莉亚

时间：2024-01-24

真是难得，今天没有什么事可做。不用躲着谁，也没人来抓我去做祷告，没想到这本质上并不特殊的一天也会得到一些特殊的待遇。

不过，在大白天坐进酒馆，看到最多的东西就是空着的椅子，莫名有些无聊。想了想，最终还是决定写信邀请几个熟人过来。

毕竟，人多了酒水还可以打折，趁此机会就多喝几杯吧。

来或不来，尽可随缘，我可不是会到处抓人的值班修女。

主题：普通的一天。

发件人：罗莎莉亚

时间：2023-01-24

事先说明，虽然你可能知道今天是什么日子，但我写信只是简单跟你问声好，没什么别的想法。

生活中的每一天都很重要，都该好好度过。只要乐意，每天都可以庆祝，没必要非等到生日。

所以，把生日过成普通的一天自然也不是坏事，自己开心就够了。

总之，晚些时候我打算去酒馆喝点酒。

这阵子酒馆里有些自大的家伙，说只要能在七圣召唤上赢过他们，当晚的酒钱就由他们买单。

挺划算。

主题：今天…

发件人：罗莎莉亚

时间：2022-01-24

坦白说，我不想过什么生日，对「传统意义上」与之相伴的应酬更是毫无兴趣。因此，知道这个日子的人寥寥无几。

如果只将这天视作稍稍特殊的一天，和许久未见的人喝些酒吃顿饭…我想我还是能接受的。

给你带了些花。花店的那个什么萝拉说，这是近期卖得最好的一种。

…至少看上去是挺有趣的，会转呢。

美好的事物，能给人带去不一样的心情。它与我并不相配，但若是在你手中，想必会有所不同。

总之，天亮了再来找我吧。
